task.title: Keep gateway session IDs out of Emacs header labels
task.objective: Preserve opaque session IDs for transport continuity while exposing only local new or active state in UI presentation
acceptance_criteria: Adversarial session IDs are not reflected in the header
The header reports new without an ID and active whenever an ID exists
Transport storage and reuse preserve the exact opaque ID

attempts.summary: Added a regression using a newline-bearing remote session ID
attempts.diagnostic: The prior header rendered the raw remote ID into presentation output

attempts.summary: Mapped session-ID presence to fixed active or new header labels while retaining the exact transport value
Expanded review coverage to newline-bearing, bidirectional-format-bearing, and oversized opaque IDs
attempts.diagnostic: Review found that the initial regression did not cover format-bearing or oversized identifiers

outcome.summary: Emacs headers expose only local session presence while exact remote identifiers remain transport-only

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1114

lessons: Opaque transport identifiers should cross UI boundaries through state mapping rather than direct rendering
Boundary tests should include control-bearing, format-bearing, and oversized opaque values
